steps.content: After cleaning up the overactive filth, you use Hella's pipe to lift a strange cloak lying in a corner.
...No, it's not a cloak. It's a raincoat. Its owner is nowhere to be found, and its inside is covered in highly developed Mania contamination, dripping down to the ground.

steps.speaker: Man In Raincoat
steps.content: Your wish... will be granted...

steps.speaker: Man In Raincoat
steps.content: <size=44>I... witness!</size>

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I remember this! It's the raincoat guy from the carnival!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Was this kind of raincoat found near all the mutated executive officers?

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: Just a moment, I've already contacted someone to check the belongings of the deceased. Besides...
She nods at an armed personnel next to her, who immediately walks toward you, holding a dark ziploc bag.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: Most people here haven't seen a real Corruptor. What you're holding may be too shocking to them. Keep it sealed.

Indeed, even in your experience, the contamination here looks very showy. It keeps morphing and making a twisting noise, as if emphasizing its existence constantly. Rather than destruction, it looks more like a revolting performance.
It's different from the Mania that took lives discreetly in your memories. Your head feels heavy, and you keep thinking as you pour the filth in your hands into the bag.
Just when your finish sealing the bag, the scar-faced man before you snickers suddenly and whispers to you in a hushed, weird voice.

steps.speaker: Armed Personnel
steps.content: Smarty-pants, Sinner, big shot... The monster who killed that monster... You're not one of us, but the so-called Chief...

steps.speaker: Armed Personnel
steps.content: Oh, you even know how to fake death... you deceived everyone... in plain sight... How brave...

steps.speaker: Armed Personnel
steps.content: I'm sure you've got an insider working for you...
Hecate freezes suddenly.

steps.speaker: Armed Personnel
steps.content: The person who shot you, who worked for you, runs fast and hides well. I couldn't see clearly... Sir, do you know... who he is?
steps.female_content: The person who shot you, who worked for you, runs fast and hides well. I couldn't see clearly... Miss, do you know... who he is?

steps.speaker: Options
options: Why don't you investigate it yourself?
Tell your boss Julien to come ask me directly.

steps.content: You can't be bothered to respond to such blatant provocation. From these words, you can tell that "Rust" is being suspected, but not completely exposed. Considering his style, he wouldn't reveal himself while rescuing two Sinners.
Telling yourself that no pain no gain to ease the annoyed feelings, you turn to bypass the man and make your way back.
Outside the fences, you see through the window that many inhabitants have gathered in the building somehow.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: Everything is okay now. The threat has been completely removed. Once the clean-up force tidies the place, you can reopen your businesses again.
People are looking at you, their faces full of vigilance and distrust. You scan across the crowd and recognize Greta, that doctor who took you to yooga.
But he immediately evades your gaze, and his first reaction is to hide.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: I got their response. All the mutated guys had something like this raincoat around them.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: Now, what are you going to do next, expert?

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: ...${PlayerName}? You don't look well, what's wrong?

steps.speaker: Options
options: ...Nothing. Let's move on to the next place.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I just still have no clue. Let's hurry up with the investigation.
You're only cooperating with them. You barely know them, and neither do they know you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Let's go somewhere with fewer people. More people means higher risks.

steps.speaker: Armed Personnel
steps.content: Haha... Is it the risk of being hated... You're not hurt, are you? Here...
He smiles and points at his own heart, but a voice stops him abruptly.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: ...Shut up, Nakamura.
The gentle red-haired logistics officer's voice suddenly turns cold and stern. The man named Nakamura straightens up reflexively. His colleagues follow suit.
After a brief silence, Lavina begins slowly.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: I almost forgot. The girl took the two wraps for you. You've been working busily on an empty stomach. I reckon you haven't gotten much sleep either, have you?

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: That's not good... This only means the logistics department hasn't done their job properly. ${PlayerName}, come with me.

steps.speaker: Options
options: Time is running short. I have to go and investigate.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: How can you think when you're sleep-deprived and starving? You'll waste more time if you faint.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: <size=44>Come. With. Me.</size>
Are you really out of strength? As you hesitate, you feel yourself straighten up as well. Then, right in front of everyone, the logistics officer drags you away.
